answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the crystal queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 901 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the relic. The falcon index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 170 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
